critical.issue: COLLECTION-NAME MISMATCH — routes/gateway.py:216 queries db.solidarity_campaigns while all campaigns are persisted in db.campaigns via routes/legacy.py:50 (verified by successful /donate on same campaign). Endpoint returns 404 'Campaign not found' before the Stripe-key check runs, meaning the expected 503 stripe_key_missing is UNREACHABLE and — critically — even with a real Stripe key in place, checkout would still 404 for every real campaign. Also idempotent /solidarity/checkout/status/{session_id} writes back to db.solidarity_campaigns (line 267) whereas raise_amount/supporters counters actually live in db.campaigns → paid donations would fail to be reflected in the campaign totals. FIX: rename db.solidarity_campaigns → db.campaigns in routes/gateway.py (both lines 216 and 267).

ui_bugs.issue: When the Stripe checkout endpoint 404s (see backend critical bug), the UI momentarily flashes the raw JSON error banner '404: {"detail":"Campaign not found"}' at the top of /solidarity before disappearing. The friendly Slovak stripe_key_missing message triggers only on status 503. Once backend collection mismatch is fixed, the friendly message will render; alternatively wrap the fetch in a catch-all that maps any non-2xx (not just 503) to the Slovak Stripe-not-configured info.

After successful POST /gateway/grants the returned token is not persistently visible via a testID='pr-token' element (spec requested pr-token shown). Grant DOES appear in the list with token preview (gwk_…) — flow works — but the one-time full-token reveal for copy-paste is either shown via a native Alert (invisible to Playwright) or missing on web. Consider rendering the full token in a copy-to-clipboard row after grant creation.

rca_of_issue: CRITICAL BUG — Stripe Checkout Collection Mismatch. Reproduction: (1) POST /api/solidarity/campaigns (via legacy.py) creates a campaign document in Mongo collection `campaigns`. (2) POST /api/solidarity/campaigns/{cid}/checkout (via gateway.py) executes `db.solidarity_campaigns.find_one({campaign_id: cid})` — returns None because that collection is empty. (3) Endpoint raises HTTPException(404, 'Campaign not found') BEFORE the Stripe-key readiness check on line 219, so the expected 503 stripe_key_missing is unreachable AND once a real Stripe key is deployed, checkout will still 404 for every real campaign. Additional impact: on lines 262-270, successful Stripe webhook verification would try to $inc raised_amount/supporters on `solidarity_campaigns` — a phantom collection — so paid donations would silently fail to update campaign totals. Fix (one-line, two places): change `db.solidarity_campaigns` → `db.campaigns` on lines 216 and 267 of /app/backend/routes/gateway.py. Verification after fix: rerun test_phase13_gateway.py::TestStripeOnramp — test_02 should turn green (503 with 'stripe_key_missing'). Related frontend hardening: solidarity.tsx donate-card should map any non-2xx response (not just 503) to a friendly Slovak banner, so a similar backend regression never leaks raw JSON to end users.
